name: Google Ads Reports
summary: Exported Google Ads performance reports covering spend, clicks, impressions, and recorded conversions per campaign.
whatItContains: Campaign, ad group, or keyword rows with date range, cost, impressions, clicks, click-through rate, average cost per click, recorded conversions, and conversion value where conversion tracking is configured.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Compare spend and recorded results across campaigns
Highlight spend that produced no recorded conversions
Point out campaigns or search terms worth investigating
Explain performance changes in plain language for review
accessMethod: Manual CSV or spreadsheet export from the Google Ads reporting interface
